sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default value when something is Nothing — combined with the forever combinator that repeats an action indefinitely
sketches.resonance: When someone is gone, you replace their absence with a default, and you do this forever — the type system encodes the shape of grieving.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type, which indicates a function that never returns — combined with a recursive call that represents an unreachable promise
sketches.resonance: A function that promises to return 'you' but whose return type is 'never' — the type system knows before we do that some arrivals are impossible.

sketches.mechanism: The 'ensure' block runs whether an exception occurs or not — it is the code that executes regardless of success or failure, the thing that happens no matter what
sketches.resonance: No matter how the attempt ends — whether it succeeds or fails, whether the error is caught or not — the body remembers; ensure is the involuntary memory of the program.
sketches.draft:
begin
  sleep
rescue
  retry
ensure
  $touched = true
end
